proposed_item_edits.preserve_statement: Assume Countable Choice $\mathrm{AC}_\omega$. Let F be a C² transversely oriented codimension-one foliation of a closed oriented 3-manifold M. If a leaf L has $\Pi^j_1(L,x)\ne0$ for one side j and base point x, then L is compact and is a boundary leaf of a distinct foliation component in the sense of [[def-foliation-component-by-mutual-positive-transverse-accessibility]]: there is a mutual-accessibility component S with $S\cap L=\varnothing$ and $L\subseteq\partial_M S$. The boundary is the ambient topological boundary.
proposed_item_edits.replace_strategy: Retain the exact arbitrary nonzero Π input and distinct mutual-positive-accessibility boundary conclusion. The first unsupplied geometric carrier is compatible finite fence reduction, not the extremal-parameter argument. At an upper lifted crossing, the cut subloop need only close near that upper level: its return holonomy may stop fixing levels farther left. Replace the asserted globally closed projected subfamily by its maximal interval of closed null loops. The endpoint lemma in this repair draft proves essentiality at the lower endpoint once compact-nullhomotopy persistence and continuous endpoint tracks are available. To finish reduction one must still prove a finite complexity measure, finite compatible rounding, and regular planar cap construction throughout the resulting interval. After that, prove positive-parameter cap continuation/uniqueness, finite-endpoint continuity and an infinite track, no-hit/separation, actual common-plaque recurrent crossings, nested disk control, and paired-sweep seam openness with a quantitative lateral no-exit estimate. No ambient-flow completeness theorem substitutes for leaf-synchronized cap continuation. Use openness of a transversal's saturation to transfer absence of closed transversals and intrinsic compactness to the original leaf; separately identify the same original leaf in the boundary of a distinct accessibility class. Ordinary complement collars do not discharge the latter conclusion. Keep proof not-supplied until these exact carriers exist.

proposed_item_edits.preserve_statement: Assume Countable Choice $\mathrm{AC}_\omega$. Let $F$ be a $C^2$ transversely oriented codimension-one foliation of a closed oriented $3$-manifold $M$, let $L$ be a leaf, and fix one side $j$. If $\Pi^j_1(L,x)$ is nontrivial for some $x\in L$, then $L$ is compact and lies in the ambient boundary of a distinct foliation component $S$ defined by mutual positive transverse accessibility ([[def-foliation-component-by-mutual-positive-transverse-accessibility]]), with $S\cap L=\varnothing$. In particular, a leaf supporting a vanishing cycle has this property by [[lem-a-vanishing-cycle-determines-a-nontrivial-limitwise-nullhomotopy-class]].

For a supplied vanishing cycle, lem-a-vanishing-cycle-determines-a-nontrivial-limitwise-nullhomotopy-class produces such a class on the approached side; apply the same implication. This is a complete logical wrapper but its geometric supplier remains not-supplied. Do not substitute an embedded-input result or complement component.

proposed_item_edits.preserve_statement: Assume Countable Choice $\mathrm{AC}_\omega$. In the situation of [[lem-a-simple-vanishing-cycle-produces-a-compact-leaf]], the compact leaf $L_1$ obtained is diffeomorphic to the torus $T^2$, and there is a Reeb component $R\subseteq M$ with $\partial R=L_1$: $R$ is a compact saturated submanifold diffeomorphic to $D^2\times S^1$ with boundary leaf $L_1$, every interior leaf of $R$ is a plane, and $(R,F|_R)$ is foliated-homeomorphic to the standard Reeb component ([[def-reeb-component-in-a-cooriented-three-manifold-foliation]]). Moreover, on the side $j$ of the nonzero $\Pi^j_1$ class (the side approached by the vanishing-cycle family when one is given), $L_1$ is the limit set of every sufficiently nearby displaced leaf: for a corresponding one-sided normal fence based at the supporting leaf, there is $\varepsilon>0$ such that the leaf $A_t$ through its displaced base point has limit set exactly $L_1$ for $0<t<\varepsilon$.
proposed_item_edits.replace_strategy: Retain the arbitrary-Π input, original boundary leaf, smooth solid-torus topology, foliated homeomorphism and Π-side-only limit-set clause. Before Euler evaluation prove that the Π-side accessibility class is open, its closure W is an actual compact C² region, its entire boundary is the original leaf, and every sufficiently nearby Π-side leaf has limit set exactly that leaf. Disk nesting alone does not prove exhaustion or exclude another boundary leaf. Once W exists, the finite tangent-Euler supplier evaluates on the zero pushed-forward boundary class; a transverse normal field alone does not prove χ=0. Then use an ACω-compatible compact surface normal-form carrier to obtain the torus. Primitive torus slope realization is elementary, but root extraction also needs nearby surface-group torsion-freeness. For embedded primitive displaced loops prove genuine disk descent, compatibility of all caps, injectivity across paired-sweep seams, surjectivity onto W and a global annular return chart. Conjugacy of an increasing contracting interval germ is only the transverse part of model identification; extend it with compatible disk/annulus parametrizations and prove continuity and inverse continuity at the limiting boundary. These geometric carriers are not supplied by the source's 'as an embedding' and 'same way' sentences. Keep proof not-supplied.

proposed_item_edits.preserve_statement: Assume Countable Choice $\mathrm{AC}_\omega$. Let $F$ be a $C^2$ transversely oriented codimension-one foliation of a closed oriented $3$-manifold $M$. If either (a) some leaf $L$ of $F$ has non-injective inclusion-induced homomorphism $\pi_1(L)\to\pi_1(M)$, or (b) some closed transversal $\gamma:S^1\to M$ is null-homotopic in $M$, then $F$ contains a Reeb component ([[def-reeb-component-in-a-cooriented-three-manifold-foliation]]). Equivalently, a Reebless $C^2$ transversely oriented foliation of a closed oriented $3$-manifold has all leaves $\pi_1$-injective and all closed transversals essential (cor-reebless-leaves-are-pi-one-injective-under-novikov-hypotheses).

In either case apply lem-a-simple-vanishing-cycle-produces-a-compact-leaf and lem-the-compact-leaf-produced-by-a-vanishing-cycle-bounds-a-reeb-component. The resulting R satisfies the stated Reeb-component definition. Both alternatives are preserved; neither needs opposite-side accumulation. This logical composition does not certify the currently unsupplied selector or geometric carriers, so preserve proof not-supplied.

proposed_item_edits.preserve_statement: Assume Countable Choice $\mathrm{AC}_\omega$. Let $F$ be a $C^2$ transversely oriented codimension-one foliation of a closed oriented $3$-manifold $M$ containing no Reeb component. Then: (i) for every leaf $L$ of $F$ the inclusion-induced homomorphism $\pi_1(L)\to\pi_1(M)$ is injective; and (ii) every closed transversal to $F$ represents a nontrivial class in $\pi_1(M)$.
proposed_item_edits.replace_strategy: Conditional proof after thm-novikov-reeb-component-theorem is locally proved: if any inclusion-induced leaf homomorphism were noninjective, alternative (a) would produce a Reeb component, contradicting the hypothesis. If any closed transversal were null-homotopic, alternative (b) would likewise contradict it. Hence all leaf homomorphisms are injective and every closed transversal represents a nontrivial ambient class. Preserve both conclusions and proof not-supplied while the theorem's geometric suppliers remain open.

proposed_local_additions.statement: Let c_t:[0,1]→M, 0≤t≤b, be a jointly continuous finite plaque-transport path family in the leaf A_t, with endpoint tracks continuous and a transported basepoint. Let E={t:c_t(0)=c_t(1)}. Suppose a compact null cap for a closed c_t implies that, on a two-sided relative parameter neighborhood, the same transported family is closed and null (the compact-cap persistence hypothesis). If c_0 is closed and essential and c_b is closed and null, then there is a∈[0,b) such that c_a is closed and essential and c_t is closed and null for every a<t≤b. In particular the right-hand compatible closed family determines a nonzero limitwise-nullhomotopy class at a.
proposed_local_additions.proof: Endpoint continuity and the Hausdorff ambient diagonal make E closed. Let U be the set of parameters where c_t is closed and null. By the stipulated compact-cap persistence U is relatively open. The connected component of U containing b is (a,b] for some a≥0 (its lower endpoint cannot lie in U, because c_0 is essential). For parameters in this interval endpoint equality holds, so by closedness of E it also holds at a. If c_a were null, compact-cap persistence would put a and parameters immediately below a in U, contradicting the component endpoint; at a=0 this directly contradicts essentiality. Thus c_a is essential. On (a,b] the actual transported paths are closed null loops; the right compatible fence and the subgroup/predicate interface give Π membership. No claim is made that the cut paths close on parameters below a, or that this lemma constructs caps or a decreasing complexity measure.
